description.en: Coelurosauravus-inspired small flat reptile with continuous long tail, four distinct limbs and paired lateral membranes supported by separate non-rib rods. Support origin, exact rod count, color and static pose are artistic/uncertain; not bird wings, bat hand-wings or an animated gliding-mechanism reconstruction. Nominal nose-to-tail length excludes membrane span.
description.zh: Coelurosauravus启发小型扁伏爬行动物，身体长尾自然连续，四肢与侧方独立骨杆支撑膜可区分；支撑来源、精确杆数、配色及静态姿势属艺术或不确定范围，非鸟翼/蝙蝠手翼，不复原滑翔动画机制。名义吻尾长不计膜展宽。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
